source.scope: Frozen build8: adaptive 128-to-2048-bit joint support certification, inclusive evaluator and canonical sampling timers, SymJIT 2.25.6. All canonical source draws remain Arb1000. Later fixed-Quad changes are not measured or validated here.

archive.hash_scope: SHA256 and bytes of original uncompressed bytes; stored_path may reference an existing committed archive or another record here.

timing_limits: One run per compiler profile, three replays of one common fixed deck; shared-host unrelated workloads remain and are recorded in run JSON. Worker Duration sums and dispatch wall are distinct. No confidence interval for throughput or new MC variance/rate claim. Four profiles: Eager, uncompressed O2, compressed O2, and compressed O2 with16MiB stack. Standard-profile comparison now includes the independently completed uncompressed run; earlier pairwise analyses remain historical.
reproduction: Restore artifact_hashes logical files to their original paths (or consistently remap requests and hashes), reconstruct source at recorded HEAD plus frozen patch, use captured cargo/link commands and configs. The source-patch identity, captured dependency hashes and exact Samples are preserved. Re-run archived analysis scripts using the archived requests/results. The state is external and identified by 35 before/after hashes.
